name: Dragon Traveler
description:
About This Game

[Game Info]

Love x Comedy x Isekai = The Ultimate Bishoujo RPG! Dragon Traveler is a rom-com adventure, where you—yes, you!—become the notorious dragon Fafnir, surrounded by gorgeous girls who are way too into you!

When the tsundere princess throws her pink fists your way, the icy queen blushes at your touch, and the sweet villainess loli snuggles up close...

Every interaction brings you closer, and every touch makes her fall even harder!

From confession to chaos! Step into a heart-pounding love trap of passion and peril where YOU are the harem hero!

Will you choose the cool, elegant queen who hides a fiery heart?

Or the midnight temptress who oozes irresistible charm?

Maybe the lively forest fairy with a smile brighter than sunlight?

Not your type? Don't worry!

There's also a teasing tsundere princess!

And you can bet this heroic, sexy, man-slaying, warrior goddess won't give up without a fight!

In their onslaught of affection, there's always one girl who'll steal your heart!

They're all head-over-heels for you... now what are you gonna do about it?

[Features]

A crazy princess kicks down the dragon's lair door,

But guess what? Turns out the mighty monster's a total deadbeat!

Grab your Ultimate Isekai Handbook—things are about to get wild!

[Love, Laughs, and Utter Mayhem! You're the Hero, They're Your Waifus! ]

Bite-sized 3–5 minute chapters!Just long enough for the princess and dragon to roast each other silly while thirsty hot waifus chase you down. You'll be spamming "Next Episode!" nonstop!

[Free Poseidon on Login! Skip the Grind, Get the Glory! ]

Grab Poseidon for FREE!

AFK overnight, wake up drowning in loot!

Log in, cash out, and boom—an SSR every week like clockwork!

[100% Chance to Pull Who You Want!Get Your Dream Character in 50 Pulls or Less!]

Dream waifu dodging you? ❌ Not for long!

50 rolls = guaranteed score! Around here, luck is mandatory. 💯

[AFK = 30,000 Diamonds! Instant Boosts, Endless Loot! ]

A 30,000+ Diamond landslide just for AFKing?! Zero sweat, all BLING! Stress-free leveling!

[Confess Your Love! Heartthrob Level MAX! Love's Just One Touch Away!]

Touch her head, she turns red, but push your luck and boy, you're... in for a royal beatdown!Unlock exclusive story scenes!

Alright! That's Dragon Traveler in a nutshell!

Now raise a glass—your adventure awaits! 🍻

[Final Remarks]

Hey there, brave adventurer!(✧ω✧) We're the Dragon Traveler dev team!

[The Birth of a Rom-Com RPG]

Who said adventures have to be so serious?We're tossing out the old formulas and serving up the ultimate stress-relief comedy experience—Dragon Traveler! (๑＞ڡ＜)☆

✦ Ever wondered what it's like to be chased by 100 girls at once?

Flirty onee-sans, tipsy tomboys, blushing knights...Every touch, every choice, every flirt brings their affection skyrocketing!It all starts with one confession... and before you know it, you're trapped in a dangerously sweet love adventure!Oh no—it's that feeling again... Why are they all so darn forward?!

✦ Looks like an idle game, plays like a rom-com battle sim!

Each round lasts just 3 minutes—no stress, all laughs. It's like sipping coffee while watching your favorite anime!Hilarious faces, wild reversals, over-the-top attacks—you'll laugh your way to victory!

[About That Useless Dragon...]

Don't let Fafnir's lazy look fool you—we've loaded him up with a ton of hidden power!

✦ The team clown by day, a one-hit powerhouse when the going gets tough!

✦ His exclusive Dragon Soul system turns lazy idling into strategic brilliance!

✦ Activate his ultimate skill to wipe the screen clean—and all your worries with it!

[Our Vision]

This isn't just an idle RPG—it's a rom-com TV show from another world!Every stage feels like a new anime opening. Every login ends with a post-credit gag!Jump in now to summon your auto-battling heroine troupe and enjoy a nonstop comedy show from another dimension!
short_desc: Love x Comedy x Isekai = The Ultimate Bishoujo RPG! Welcome to the wild world of Dragon Traveler!
